performance_case.causal_mechanism: A completed 3 percent BTC UTC-day shock may create a repeatable direction-conditioned next-24-hour response. A positive shock-signed response represents continuation and a negative response represents reversal, while fixed 1-hour and 6-hour responses reveal path instability without selecting a different primary horizon.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may freeze only the pre-outcome event-to-label timeline, formulas, breadth gates, spot-only interpretation boundary, and one later matched-capital experiment boundary. It cannot inspect an eligible outcome, choose continuation or reversal, implement an evaluator, author or register a hypothesis, candidate, manifest, or OOS trigger, deploy, or change any source, schedule, server, canonical state, or Trading path.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A later separately preregistered spot-feasible overlay could reduce adverse post-shock paths only if both direction breadth and matched-capital drawdown evidence improve without hiding terminal inventory or missed participation; all such value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Freezing the response contract before outcomes prevents horizon and direction selection after seeing rare shocks and creates useful work while forward evidence matures. The alternative is idle waiting or repeated historical mining, both of which delay learning or increase false discovery without improving credible performance evidence.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The design itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its potential value is shortening the time from a future sealed shock episode to an honest continuation, reversal, or no-effect disposition and then permitting at most one bounded spot-feasible matched-capital experiment without post-outcome tuning.
